SELECT
  "time",
  container_name AS "metric",
  (nps_si * cores) / 1000000.0 AS "value"
FROM 
  metrics
WHERE 
  container_name != 'fishnet-0'
  AND "time" > $__timeFrom() -- Nutzt den Zeitfilter von Grafana
ORDER BY 
  1, 2;

SELECT
  container_name AS "metric",
  AVG(nps_si * cores) / 1000000 AS "value"
FROM (
  SELECT
    container_name,
    nps_si,
    cores,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY container_name ORDER BY "time" DESC) as rn
  FROM 
    metrics
  WHERE 
    container_name != 'fishnet-0'
    AND "time" > NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'
) AS subquery
WHERE 
  rn <= 2 -- Durchschnitt der letzten 2 Zeilen
GROUP BY 
  container_name
ORDER BY 
  container_name ASC;

SELECT
  SUM(nps_per_worker) AS "Gesamt-Speed"
FROM (
  SELECT
    container_name,
    (MAX(total_nodes) - MIN(total_nodes)) / 
    NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX("time") - MIN("time"))), 0) AS nps_per_worker
  FROM 
    worker_stats
  WHERE 
    "time" > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  GROUP BY 
    container_name
) AS subquery

SELECT
  all_workers.container_name AS "metric",
  COALESCE(recent_speed.nps, 0) / 1000000 AS "value" -- Hier erzwingen wir Mega
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT container_name 
  FROM worker_stats 
  WHERE container_name != 'fishnet-0'
) AS all_workers
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    container_name,
    (MAX(total_nodes) - MIN(total_nodes)) / 
    NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX("time") - MIN("time"))), 0) AS nps
  FROM 
    worker_stats
  WHERE 
    "time" > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
    AND container_name != 'fishnet-0'
  GROUP BY 
    container_name
) AS recent_speed ON all_workers.container_name = recent_speed.container_name
ORDER BY 
  all_workers.container_name ASC;

SELECT
  time_clean AS "time",
  metric AS "metric",
  value
FROM (
  SELECT
    ws.time_clean,
    ws.container_name AS metric,
    SUM(ws.diff) / NULLIF(SUM(m.batch_count), 0) AS value
  FROM (
    SELECT
      $__timeGroup("time"::timestamp, $__interval) AS time_clean,
      container_name,
      (MAX(total_nodes) - MIN(total_nodes)) AS diff
    FROM worker_stats
    WHERE $__timeFilter("time"::timestamp)
    GROUP BY 1, 2
  ) AS ws
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      $__timeGroup("time"::timestamp, $__interval) AS time_clean,
      container_name,
      COUNT(DISTINCT batch_id) AS batch_count
    FROM metrics
    WHERE $__timeFilter("time"::timestamp)
    GROUP BY 1, 2
  ) AS m ON ws.time_clean = m.time_clean AND ws.container_name = m.container_name
  GROUP BY 1, 2
) AS final_result
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  time_clean AS "time",
  SUM(diff) AS "value"
FROM (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroup("time"::timestamp, $__interval) AS time_clean,
    container_name,
    MAX(total_nodes) - MIN(total_nodes) AS diff
  FROM 
    worker_stats
  WHERE 
    $__timeFilter("time"::timestamp)
  GROUP BY 
    1, 2
) AS subquery
GROUP BY 
  1
ORDER BY 
  1

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias("time", $__interval),
  COUNT(batch_id) AS "value"
FROM
  metrics
WHERE
  $__timeFilter("time")
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  1

SELECT

    MAX(total_nodes) - MIN(total_nodes) AS diff
  FROM 
    worker_stats
  WHERE 
    $__timeFilter("time"::timestamp)
  GROUP BY

GROUP BY

ORDER BY

SELECT
  time_bucket AS "time",
  SUM(nps_per_worker) AS "Gesamt-Speed_SI"
FROM (
  SELECT
    container_name,
    $__timeGroup("time", 1h) AS time_bucket,
    (MAX(total_nodes) - MIN(total_nodes)) / 
    NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX("time") - MIN("time"))), 0) AS nps_per_worker
  FROM 
    worker_stats
  WHERE 
    $__timeFilter("time")
  GROUP BY 
    container_name, time_bucket
) AS subquery
WHERE nps_per_worker > 0
GROUP BY 
  1
ORDER BY 
  1;
SELECT variant, COUNT(variant) FROM metrics WHERE $__timeFilter("time") GROUP BY variant ORDER BY variant LIMIT 50

SELECT
  container_name AS "metric",
  COALESCE(
    (MAX(total_nodes) - MIN(total_nodes)) / 
    NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX("time") - MIN("time"))), 0), 
    0
  ) AS "value"
FROM 
  worker_stats
WHERE 
  "time" > NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' -- Zeitraum etwas größer wählen für Stabilität
GROUP BY 
  container_name
ORDER BY 
  "container_name" ASC; -- Die "Sorgenkinder" mit 0 stehen dann ganz oben
